text: Meet Rally, a meeting guide built with Meta AI. It helps a host keep the conversation moving, then saves the evidence behind each decision. This video uses a labeled synthetic replay. The production app combines Meta transcription, reasoning, and speech.

Start with a decision, an agenda, and the time available. Muse Spark prepares the plan. Choose quiet observation, balanced guidance, or a more active approach. Rally can join Teams with voice and video. You can also use a microphone or a browser call tab.

Muse Voice Transcribe turns speech into a live transcript. Muse Spark follows the agenda, time, and unresolved questions. It can respond before a long turn ends. The animated presence shows Rally's assessment. It does not analyze the emotions of people in the meeting.
Ask Rally what still needs an owner. Meta SeamlessM4T voices its reply. The host can pause or stop speech. On a phone, the plan and transcript stay close at hand.

When the meeting ends, Muse Spark reviews the complete transcript. Conditions stay attached to decisions. Missing owners and dates stay unresolved. Follow the source links, add a correction, or download a PDF. Share the report with a named Rally account, and revoke access when needed.

Meta models support the whole loop. Muse Voice Transcribe listens. Muse Spark plans, guides, and reviews. SeamlessM4T speaks. Local Meta MMS narrates this video, and provides another voice option. Rally brings these capabilities together with host controls and source evidence.

Today, Rally turns discussion into clear next steps. Our next step is one workspace for preparation, conversation, and follow through. The promise stays simple. Know what was decided, who owns it, and why.
